column1: # Flat and tab-separated on purpose: cabletv.lua parses this with two string
# patterns and no JSON parser. Lua has no JSON in the standard library, and
# regexing real JSON is how you get a frozen box (see constraint 4) — so
# whatever ends up generating this file does the parsing, not the player.
#   kind   "movie" (page 993) or "show" (page 994). Anything else is skipped.
#   title  Display name. Sorted by this, so it is also the letter-jump key.
#   year   Shown right-aligned. May be empty.
#   url    What mpv loadfiles when you press OK. MAY BE EMPTY — an entry with
#          no url shows "NO SOURCE" on the banner and plays nothing.
# Everything below is a PLACEHOLDER: real titles, deliberately no urls. The
# catalogue browser is finished and works; the backend that fills the url
# column is not wired up yet. To fill it, regenerate this whole file — nothing
# in here is hand-maintained state, unlike channels.m3u where the numbers are
# The titles are public-domain films and series, so this list is also a
# legitimate shopping list: every one of them can be pointed at a real url

column2: The Man Who Knew Too Much
